newBodies.name: Northwest Community College
newBodies.notes: Founded in 1975 and renamed Coast Mountain College on 18 June 2018 (a rename, not an amalgamation). Its logos are dated by the publications that carry them, not by their adoption.

sources.title: Province of B.C., name change announcement (2018AEST0056)

northwest-community-college.fidelityNote: The publication’s own vector paths, copied from the PDF with their placement, colours, curves and clipping; unrelated page objects removed and a small transparent margin added. Lettering is outlined in the source. No tracing or redrawing. Supplied 27 November 2026 with its provenance (research/identity/nwcc-vector-2026-11-27).
northwest-community-college.label: Northwest Community College: Thunderbird and wordmark
northwest-community-college.sourceLocator: 2015 Smithers Golf Tournament and Student Bursary Fundraiser sponsor sheet, page 1, crop [33, 124, 344, 199] pt.
northwest-community-college.dateNote: The sheet is for the tournament of 19 June 2015, which dates this use of the logo, not its adoption. The college was renamed Coast Mountain College on 18 June 2018.
northwest-community-college.notes: The Thunderbird beside “NORTHWEST” over a rule and “COMMUNITY COLLEGE”, in white for a dark ground, as the college printed it in 2015.

extraction.method: Direct extraction of the PDF’s vector paths (supplied package)

northwest-community-college.label: Northwest Community College: Thunderbird and wordmark, colour
northwest-community-college.sourceLocator: CMTN Connection, Spring 2025 (50th anniversary), PDF page 4, printed page 6, beside the 1975 founding entry; crop [198, 244, 348, 282] pt.
northwest-community-college.dateNote: A 2025 retrospective reproduces the logo beside the college’s 1975 founding; that placement does not date this lockup. Its use is dated by the 2015 sponsor sheet.
northwest-community-college.notes: The same logo in colour: a grey-green Thunderbird and rule with the lettering in blue, as the 2025 anniversary magazine reproduces it. The colours are the PDF’s stored values (#86A7AC, #163583), not documented Pantone specifications.
